Help and limitations

Bring your reading

Use Add reading to choose a downloaded PDF, DRM-free EPUB or plain text file, or paste text. Documents are parsed on-device. Image-only scans need OCR elsewhere. Encrypted files and unusual layouts may be unsupported. Check the extracted text before reading.

Read and review

Set an average WPM. Longer words and punctuation receive more of the paragraph's time budget. Review opens surrounding text; sentence rewind returns to a sentence start. Normal text lets you read continuously and choose a restart word. No comprehension score or quiz is used.

Move from the website

In the website's Bookshelf, export a backup. On this device, choose that JSON file in Bookshelf → Backup & restore. Check the contents before confirming. Matching IDs become copies rather than overwriting readings.

Keep a backup

Store exported copies somewhere you control. The app cannot recover documents after deletion if no backup exists. If storage is unavailable, keep the app installed, unlock the device and retry; do not erase the app to troubleshoot missing documents.

Research papers

Citation skipping is optional and heuristic. Original text is retained. Unusual citation styles, tables and equations may require manual review. Dictionary entries are English and may not match the context.

Support

This is a development build. The publisher and public support contact have not yet been selected. They are required before App Store submission.
